OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The hunt platform the connector executes against.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_TYPE.description: Type of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.description: Maximum number of hunt runs OpenCTI may dispatch to this connector at the same time. The platform budget is the minimum of its own setting and this value.

CONNECTOR_OBSERVABLE_TYPES.description: Observable types the connector may create from hunt results, intersected with the types expected by each hunt. Defaults to IOC types only; supported values: IPv4-Addr, IPv6-Addr, Domain-Name, Url, StixFile, Email-Addr, Hostname, User-Account, Mac-Addr.

CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVABLES.description: Maximum number of observables created per hunt run (the most frequent first).

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_DEPLOYMENT.description: 'falcon' queries Falcon Next-Gen SIEM through the CrowdStrike API (OAuth2 client credentials); 'logscale' queries a LogScale cluster (self-hosted or LogScale Cloud) with an API token.

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_BASE_URL.description: CrowdStrike API URL of the Falcon cloud: 'https://api.crowdstrike.com' (US-1), 'https://api.us-2.crowdstrike.com', 'https://api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com' or 'https://api.laggar.gcw.crowdstrike.com' (GOV).

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_LOGSCALE_URL.description: URL of the LogScale cluster, e.g. 'https://cloud.us.humio.com' (deployment 'logscale').

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_LOGSCALE_TOKEN.description: LogScale API token with the search permission on the repository (deployment 'logscale').

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_REPOSITORY.description: Repository or view the hunts search: 'search-all' (all Falcon and third-party data), 'investigate_view', 'third-party', or a LogScale repository name.

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_VERIFY_SSL.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the API.

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_SIGMA_PIPELINE.description: pySigma pipeline(s) translating Sigma rules, chained with '+': 'crowdstrike_falcon' (Falcon telemetry), 'crowdstrike_fdr' (Falcon Data Replicator events) or 'none'.

CROWDSTRIKE_LOGSCALE_HUNT_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between two status checks of a query job, when LogScale gives no hint.
